content: Let thoughts always be lofty and grand; even if they fall short of fulfillment, the elevation of the mind remains. (Kural Maxim 6)
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation: Thiruvalluvar's Tirukkural provides a pragmatic, universal ethical manual for human life, balancing righteous living (*Aram*), purposeful work (*Porul*), and enduring love (*Inbam*).
practicalInsight: Choose one ethical principle from this verse and embody it fully in your conversations and decisions today.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of my life is my conduct falling short of my highest ethical knowledge?
